_docs.purpose: Single source of truth for every dnf-managed package in the image
_docs.how-to-add: Add the package name to the group whose REPO WINDOW it resolves in — not the group whose subject matter it fits. The module that consumes that group handles repo enable/disable and flags. Groups map 1:1 to build module scripts (see files/scripts/lib/packages-lib). This file must stay PLAIN JSON: packages-lib reads it with jq, which rejects comments — record verified names and repo provenance in the group's entry below, never as inline comments.

groups.programming: Language toolchains from Fedora — python3, nodejs, gcc-c++, cargo, cmake, golang, perl. Installed FIRST in Stage 03, before every other group, so later groups and stages can rely on the toolchains (gcc backs RPM builds; python3 backs the pip/pipx stages). NOTE: the Go toolchain package is golang — no package named just go exists on Fedora 44 (verified 2026-09-26).
groups.core: Desktop/base packages from Fedora repos (Stage 03). The @custom-environment comps group stays hardcoded in Stage 03 (comps groups are not catalog entries).
groups.editors: Editors and language runtimes from Fedora (Stage 03). Split out of vendor-apps, which they were never resolved from — they only worked because they installed inside the vscode/brave repo window.
groups.desktop: Hyprland desktop stack, resolved from COPR aahsnr-work/halcyon (priority=1, copr-enabled in Stage 00 — installed in Stage 03). Weak deps are OFF — list every stack weak dep explicitly.
groups.ublueos-packages: Everything resolved from COPR ublue-os/packages (Stage 03): bazaar plus the ublue-os-just/uupd machinery. Absorbs the former bazaar-copr and ujust-copr groups — Stage 08 no longer installs from this COPR, it only consumes ujust-fedora.
groups.vendor-apps: Resolved from the per-use vendor repos written inline in Stage 03 (vscode, brave) — NOTHING ELSE belongs here. brave-origin is a hard member since the vendor-apps-optional skip-unavailable path was removed.
groups.cli-tools: Former brew formulas — CLI user tools from Fedora (Stage 05). bun, pixi and opencode moved here from the retired Homebrew payload — COPR aahsnr-work/halcyon-cli (2026-09-29).
groups.devtools: Former brew formulas available in Fedora (Stage 05).
groups.misc: Packages that fit no other group (Stage 05).
groups.ujust-fedora: Fedora companions of the ujust tooling (Stage 08). grubby backs the kernel-arg recipes (and hard-requires grub2-tools). stress-ng powers the 'ujust benchmark' recipe (80-halcyon.just runs stress-ng --matrix). glow is a deliberate user-facing terminal markdown renderer — no recipe consumes it today, so nothing gates it. ugum falls back to fzf when gum is absent, so gum is NOT required. NOTE: the wget BINARY on F44 comes from wget2-wget (verified 2026-09-20 — no package named just wget exists on Fedora 44).
groups.terra: Resolved EXCLUSIVELY from Terra repos (Stage 04 uses --disablerepo='*'). Terra-release/-mesa/-multimedia are repo bootstrap and stay hardcoded there. Shrunk to the Terra-only leftovers — zed, zen-browser, the nerd fonts, starship, yazi, zellij and lazygit moved to the halcyon groups (2026-09-29).
groups.exclude-all: The 'exclude' block drives remove-packages (Stage 2); entries are resolved through rpm -qa first, so absent names are tolerated.
groups.halcyon-apps: RPM apps from COPR aahsnr-work/halcyon-apps (apps/install-built-apps — Stage 07): obsidian, zotero, distroshelf, onlyoffice-desktopeditors, bitwarden, ticktick. Replaces the AppImage/tarball scripts and the four transition flatpaks (2026-09-29).
groups.halcyon-texlive: TeX Live from COPR aahsnr-work/halcyon-texlive (apps/install-built-apps — Stage 07): texlive-meta replaces the CTAN tlnet installer and covers latexmk/biber (2026-09-29).

_docs.build-tool-dependencies: git, curl and jq are hard preconditions of packages-lib; gnupg2 stays as a general build/verify tool; gcc-c++ (programming) backs RPM builds. The brew-specific entries (zstd payload packing, setpriv uid drop) were retired with the Homebrew stage (2026-09-29).
